en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a seaside promenade lined with trees and people walking along the waterfront. Low-rise buildings extend inland toward hills and a mountain in the background. The image has a white border with a scalloped edge. Handwritten Greek text appears at the bottom left and right, and a printed website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is overlaid across the lower-right portion of the image.
